scientific_integrity.claim_limits: An explicit two-token, two-head, unit-sphere normalized discrete-time model; only local exponential stability and local persistence are proven. No universal multihead attraction, global basin, or nonlinear behavior beyond local fixed-point stability is asserted.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Exact Jacobian spectrum and elementary discrete local contraction; isolated-head expansion derived algebraically.
scientific_integrity.validation_status: Self-review mathematical reconstruction and standalone finite numerical checks; independent validation not performed.
